header: My rule: a document that does not answer the question must not wear a confident "87% MATCH" (step 61a; ledger item 57). On 26 Oct 2026 "list the employees of the centre for human resource development" found nothing it could answer, fell to the circular search and showed "Circular-Health check-up for non-executive employees during the month of December" at 87%: nothing in it is about the question. The search is by MEANING, so a good hit can share no word with the question; a weak one can score 87%. I made the rule only a LABEL, never a hiding: a result is WEAK when
- none of the question's content words (words that are not stop words, nor generic ones like "employees", "list", "circular") appears in its title or its best passage, AND
- it is not a perfect (quoted) match, AND
A weak result keeps its place and its link but loses its percentage, and when ALL the results are weak I make the screen say so in one line. Pure (no server code).

doc: Returns the words of a question that say WHAT it is about, each cut to its first five letters, so "contractor" finds "contract" and "development" finds "developments".

doc: I return the same results with each weak one marked (weakMatch) and stripped of its percentage; when nothing is weak, the array itself is returned.

behaviours: the content words of the owner's question: centre, human, resource, development (not 'list', 'employees', 'the', 'of', 'for')
the health check-up circular at 87% is WEAK for it (it shares no content word)
...it keeps its place and its title but loses its percentage and is marked
'mediclaim renewal last date' / 'Extension of SAIL Mediclaim policy (2026-2027)' at 88%: not weak
'contractor wages 2024' finds 'Revision of wages of contract workers' (the stem 'contr')
a word in the best PASSAGE counts, not only the title
a perfect (quoted) match is never weak
a VERY confident hit by meaning (90% or more) is never weak even with no shared word
...the same hit at 85% is labelled (it is only a label)
matchPercentage (0 to 100) is read like a similarity: 92 is confident
a question with NO content word ('list the employees') calls nothing weak
a question in Hindi or Bengali is compared by its own words (unicode letters)
in a list only the weak one is changed; the good one is the SAME object
when nothing is weak the SAME array comes back (no new render)
the hook marks the weak results once (useMemo), from the question that was searched
the modal says so in one line when every result is weak (and not in Deep Synthesis)
the note is the one in the module
